12522.name: Cam Ward
12522.headline: Struggling second-year QB; Titans' deadline choices revolve around him

12519.name: Luther Burden III
12519.headline: Concussion after 7-97 night; Week 10 bye helps recovery
12519.news: Burden caught seven passes for 97 yards in Chicago's 27-24 Sunday night win over Tampa Bay on Nov. 8, then suffered a concussion in the fourth quarter on an unflagged hit from Buccaneers rookie Rueben Bain after a catch. He fumbled on the play, and Tampa Bay tied the game shortly after he was helped off. Sleeper credited him with 17.2 half-PPR points on 34 snaps, which suggests a touchdown we couldn't independently confirm. Ben Johnson confirmed the concussion; Burden has to clear the protocol, and reports note it's his second documented concussion in two years. The Week 10 bye gives him about two weeks before the Nov. 22 game against New Orleans.
12519.take: Before the injury he was having his best game of the season, and he has been producing every week as a central part of the passing game. The bye means he misses no extra games if he clears the protocol on a normal timeline, but a second concussion in two years adds some uncertainty. In redraft, Chicago is on bye this week anyway, so hold him and expect him back as a WR3 with upside. In dynasty, worried managers may sell him cheaply, so he's still a buy for a rebuilding team.

The Giants are a better matchup than the Rams, so he is a reasonable RB2/flex start in 12-team redraft for one more week. Once Croskey-Merritt is back, White probably drops to a passing-down and trailing-script role with much less value. In dynasty, he's a 27-year-old veteran with only a short window as the lead back, so the 1-8 rebuilding team should sell him to an RB-needy contender while he's starting. Weekend Warriors favor youth, so they're probably not the buyer.
